# Contact Point Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ContactPointType`](gmeow-ContactPointType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ContactPointType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/contacts`](../../slices/contacts.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The usage role of a contact point — a VALUE vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses). Personal, work, personal-domain, support, billing, and emergency are examples; the set is open. Projects to [schema:contactType](https://schema.org/contactType) and the vCard TYPE parameter.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ContactPointType`](gmeow-ContactPointType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for the contact-point-usage axis — the open set of roles (personal, work, support, …) a channel declares through [`gmeow:contactPointType`](../properties/gmeow-contactPointType.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting per-role subclasses (roles are individuals, P9) and avoid using it for the issuing organization (that is [`gmeow:contactPointProvider`](../properties/gmeow-contactPointProvider.md)).

### How to use

- Reference a seeded role individual from a contact point via [`gmeow:contactPointType`](../properties/gmeow-contactPointType.md), or mint a new individual when a fresh role appears; it projects to [schema:contactType](https://schema.org/contactType) and the vCard TYPE parameter.

### Examples

- ex:contactPointTypeBilling a [`gmeow:ContactPointType`](gmeow-ContactPointType.md); [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "billing"@en.
